new_rules.meaning: Bind used PDF 2.0 custom EA-PDF tags to the registered EA-PDF namespace and resolve RoleMapNS targets transitively. new_rules.meaning: PDF 2.0 / PDF/A-4 files with logical structure must conform to ISO/TS 32005 and include its PDF Declaration in document-level XMP. This applies even without custom EA-PDF tags. The PDF Declarations namespace is http://pdfa.org/declarations/; declarations is a Bag of structures with a required conformsTo URI whose registered ISO identifier is https://pdfa.org/declarations#iso32005. new_rules.meaning: For all profiles: pdfmailid:rev is integer with value 2024. This is the integer value 2024, not a canonical spelling requirement: permitted signs, zero padding and XML whitespace retain that value. RDF URI and array/structure values cannot supply the simple integer.

new_rules.meaning: EA-PDF 9.8 requires the first dc:creator item to be recorded. dc:creator is an ordered array of creator names (person, organization or service), not a field reserved for a software product. Preserve its standard XMP type; do not infer invalidity from an email-like value. A later nonempty sequence member does not populate an empty or missing first creator item. The array must be rdf:Seq and every supplied member must be normal ProperName Text.

new_rules.meaning: dc:creator identifies the entity primarily responsible for the resource, as an ordered array of names. EA-PDF requires its first item; neither EA-PDF nor the reviewed XMP definition requires a software-name pattern. Actual incorrect attribution requires provenance evidence; punctuation, address-like text or equality to an email sender alone is insufficient. Mailbox-like spelling or equality with an email sender is not evidence of incorrect attribution. Without independent creation provenance, report attribution as unavailable rather than assert PASS or FAIL.

source_order.basis: Earliest applicable linked source page; ties by section, table, source requirement and stable predicate order.

new_rules.meaning: EA-PDF requires pdf:Producer to be recorded; the XMP PDF schema defines it as the name of the tool that created the PDF. No product-name grammar, version suffix or ban on address-like text is specified. The supplied field must be normal AgentName Text; URI, array and structured substitutions cannot satisfy it.

source_order.basis: Earliest applicable linked source page; ties by section, table, source requirement and stable predicate order.

new_rules.meaning: pdf:Producer denotes the PDF creation tool. Evaluate contradictions only with reliable provenance; a lexical heuristic alone cannot establish an incorrect tool identity. Mailbox-like spelling or equality with an email sender is not evidence of incorrect attribution. Without independent creation provenance, report attribution as unavailable rather than assert PASS or FAIL.

source_order.basis: Earliest applicable linked source page; ties by section, table, source requirement and stable predicate order.

new_rules.meaning: xmp:CreateDate must be a normal XMP Date for creation of this EA-PDF. Local interpretation: use the PDF creation event, not the source email date. Reduced precision and an unknown timezone are allowed by XMP; invalid dates and URI/array values are not. This rule checks the value type, not provenance.

new_rules.meaning: EA-PDF 1.0 section 9.8 identifies xmp:CreateDate as the EA-PDF file creation date. Without such evidence report provenance unavailable; required field presence and XMP date validity remain separate checks.

source_order.basis: Earliest applicable linked source page; ties by section, table, source requirement and stable predicate order.

new_rules.meaning: For all profiles: Set the dc:title x-default Text item. Localized items alone do not satisfy this recommendation; Text may be empty. Failure to follow this recommendation is not a mandatory violation.
